title: Chat-First Free Activation Canary
principle: A new user must be able to type, get a useful answer, and see the next automatic free/local path without provider keys, paid services or manual architecture choices.
public_repo_rule: The public frontend may expose static app code, local installer handoffs and public-safe receipts only; provider secrets, billing, raw private data and remote execution authority stay out of GitHub Pages.

canary_path.expected: Chat composer is the first useful action and the route floor is visible before advanced panels.
When no backend is live, MMIR selects the browser helper or browser/WebGPU starter route instead of a dead no-model state.
A free browser helper, browser WebGPU route or verified backend answer creates a first-chat receipt without raw prompt or response storage.
Mac installer package downloads a checked connector server, installs/starts Ollama and a starter model, starts localhost connector and returns to MMIR for proof.
If a local node exposes a model, MMIR probes /chat/completions only on free/local-looking routes, selects the verified model and prepares first chat.

journeys.name: Instant free chat
journeys.user_goal: Open MMIR and get a useful answer immediately.
journeys.automatic_path: Browser helper is selected when no live backend exists; first answer writes a local receipt.

journeys.name: Add Mac local node
journeys.user_goal: Download one Mac package, run it, then see the node/model become active in chat.
journeys.automatic_path: Mac package installs private Node runtime when needed, installs/starts Ollama, pulls a starter model, starts localhost connector and returns to MMIR.
journeys.completion_signal: local_node_health=ready; /models returns at least one model; proof status verified

journeys.name: Add Windows, Linux, Raspberry Pi or VM node
journeys.user_goal: Turn any owned device into a trusted MMIR node.
journeys.automatic_path: Platform installers use localhost defaults, pairing, Ollama starter model and post-install return proof.
journeys.completion_signal: node dashboard sees health, hardware, models and tunnel policy

journeys.name: Choose or combine models
journeys.user_goal: Use live local models, browser helpers, WebGPU candidates and installable free models from one picker.
journeys.automatic_path: Model picker keeps the free route floor visible and prefers verified live routes when available.
journeys.completion_signal: selected model has live, browser-helper, browser-webgpu or installable-free state

journeys.name: Connect paid/SaaS/API-key providers safely
journeys.user_goal: Use external providers without exposing keys in the public frontend.
journeys.automatic_path: Provider routes stay behind protected backend auth, rate limits, audit and explicit cost policy.
journeys.completion_signal: no provider key field or bearer construction exists in GitHub Pages

evidence.result: The public page exposes #mimir-prompt, Send, Connect model and route-floor controls in the first screen.
Browser helper, browser WebGPU and backend sends now call recordFirstChatReceipt with no raw prompt/response storage.
Mac installer SERVER_SHA256 matches the published connector server LF SHA-256.
Live probes run only on free/local-looking routes; possible paid/provider routes are blocked from hidden proof calls.
Static installer contract is green; final Mac/Windows/Linux device execution still needs real-device QA before calling the install journey complete.
